name: Night Face ~Haitoku no Kikoushi~
source:
Hero used to work in a host club, but left it after his girlfriend dumped him for a more successful host. Now hero starts his own host enterprise. At this time the lover of his former girlfriend shows up and offers a challenge between them since there can be only one king of the night in the city.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角過去在男公關俱樂部工作，女友卻為了更成功的男公關拋棄了他，他也因此離職。如今，主角創辦了自己的男公關公司。就在這時，前女友的戀人現身，向他發起挑戰——這座城市只能有一個夜之王。

[譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
